  • Review
    Aug 18
    Reviewer 2

    I really enjoy using Google Photos. It makes it easy to keep my pictures organized, find older memories, and have my photos backed up in one place. I especially like being able to search for photos without scrolling through thousands of pictures. The memories feature is also a nice touch because it brings back photos I may have forgotten about. Overall, Google Photos is convenient, easy to use, and a great way to keep important memories safe and organized. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

  • Long time user
    Jun 25
    Reviewer 4

    I think I’ve used Google Photos since it’s inception, and I love all the features that it offers the ability to identify faces and quickly find people or groups of people or combinations of people and animals in Photos is really invaluable. I would say if I had any constructive criticism, it would be that the photo editing might be a little bit more robust but for all things considered it it’s been my digital repository of choice for a very long time and will continue to be so.
